variables.name: workspace
variables.title: Memory workspace
variables.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds your memory. An existing MindSlice workspace is used as is; a new or empty folder is initialized; a folder with other files is refused.

variables.name: stage_writes
variables.title: Review every write
variables.description: true: every change the agent makes waits in staging for your approval (recommended for small local models). false: only changes to always-loaded memory wait.
